title: Cambridge IELTS 17 Test 3 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The chart below gives information about how families in one country spent their weekly income in 1968 and in 2018.
scenario: The chart compares average weekly spending by families in one country in 1968 and 2018 as percentages of weekly income.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: 1968 and 2018: average weekly spending by families
notes: Two bars are shown for each category, one for 1968 and one for 2018.
